description: Build a RayTK SDF graph from copied RayTK ROP masters: primary SDF, optional secondary SDF through simpleUnion, optional basicMat, lookAtCamera, pointLight, raymarchRender3D, and a native Null TOP output. Requires RayTK to be staged with manage_packages install raytk and loaded from the staged .tox.

camera.description: Add a RayTK lookAtCamera wired to renderer input 1.

light.description: Add a RayTK pointLight wired to renderer input 2.

material.description: Insert a RayTK basicMat between the SDF chain and renderer.

name.description: Name of the container COMP created for the graph.

operation.description: Combination operation. A provided secondary upgrades none to simpleUnion.

output_name.description: Name of the native Null TOP receiving the renderer output.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path where the RayTK SDF graph container is created.

primary.description: Primary RayTK SDF primitive ROP copied from the loaded RayTK library.

render_resolution.description: RayTK renderer resolution [width, height]. Defaults to 1280x720 to avoid TouchDesigner Non-Commercial render-size warnings.

secondary.description: Optional second RayTK SDF primitive, combined with primary by simpleUnion.

name: create_raytk_sdf_graph
title: Create RayTK SDF graph
